title: Стоимость реализации для покупателя по дате заказа
order_axis_qualification: Require qualified posting-level order_date semantics or another reliable order-date source. FBS in_process_at is not automatically order creation. SKU-day quantities and seller amounts reconciliation with analytics is necessary but insufficient; retain AXIS_NOT_QUALIFIED until posting-level semantics is established.
as_of_semantics: Actual current collection timestamp; no reconstruction of past knowledge state without a saved snapshot. Late accruals may revise historical purchase results.
whole_cohort_mean_gate: qualified order axis AND exhaustive source search AND unambiguous coverage of every original ordered unit; otherwise NULL
returns: separate qualified reversal/return stream; do not count again as positive sale
payment_method: explicit source label only, unknown preserved
notes: Specification only; no marketplace data, credentials, installed handler or new background task.
